content.simple_explanation: To learn Life Processes in Animals, first understand the main idea, then identify supporting evidence/examples or steps, and finally apply the idea.
key_points: Life Processes 9 in Animals If your food is fully digested before you eat again, you won’t need medicine for pain.

(Thirukkural 942) In the Grade 6 Science textbook Curiosity, chapter ‘Living Creatures: Exploring their Characteristics’, we learnt about processes essential for survival of living beings like nutrition, respiration, excretion, and reproduction.
In this chapter, we will learn about life processes such as nutrition and respiration in detail.
Bees and sunbirds suck the nectar of ﬂowers, while infants of humans and many other animals feed on their mother’s milk.
Some aquatic animals ﬁlter tiny food particles ﬂoating nearby and feed upon them.
Animals, including humans, obtain energy from food, which enables them to carry out various life processes.
